request.subject: UNIT:CULT:EMBARKED_TRANSPORT

layers.text: Turn it into a secret-society rowing barge: the hull becomes indigo-blue lacquered wood #4a43b5 with shade #372f8f and a polished brass rim #c9a24a; the red tarp becomes an indigo-blue tarp with a pale cream #f3e7c4 border; the red pennant becomes one candle lantern with a bright green flame on the pole. Nothing red. Keep the oars, boat shape, size, thick black outline and style the same, with nothing under the hull.
